Container.Name: kvasir
Container.Overview: Kvasir — one page that answers which AI agent to start for a given task. Aggregates three live sources: CursorBench (cost, tokens and steps per task, per effort level), AI Stupid Level (model drift over time) and GitHub Copilot's models-and-pricing docs (availability and price). Every reading is archived in SQLite under /data, so the page shows today's answer and keeps the history behind it.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the page and the API

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: SQLite archive of every reading — keep it, this is the history

Config.Name: AI Stupid Level interval (min)
Config.Description: How often to poll the drift source. It re-scores hourly.

Config.Name: CursorBench interval (min)
Config.Description: How often to poll CursorBench. It changes on the scale of weeks.

Config.Name: Copilot pricing interval (min)
Config.Description: How often to re-read GitHub's models-and-pricing page.

Config.Name: Hidden models
Config.Description: Model keys not enabled in the organisation's Copilot subscription — hidden from the default view but still collected and archived.

Config.Name: AI credit tiers
Config.Description: Monthly AI-credit allocations the page reports on, as Name:credits. 1 credit = $0.01.

Config.Name: Default tier
Config.Description: Tier shown to a visitor who has never picked one. Each browser remembers its own choice.

Config.Name: Worker cost cap (USD/task)
Config.Description: Most the mid-tier agent may cost per CursorBench task.

Config.Name: Scout cost cap (USD/task)
Config.Description: Most the cheap agent may cost per CursorBench task.
